trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to show Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically modified before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to trigger the Klaro! Consent Management modal.
trans-unit.target: Klaro! Consent Management takutinneqarnissaanut URL taarserneqartoq: Linkit placeholder-URL-imut tassunga sammisut HTML-output sioqqullugu automatiskimik allanngortinneqartarput. URL CSP-mut naleqquttumik JavaScriptimik taarserneqartarpoq Klaro! Consent Management-ip modal-ia aallartinniarlugu.

trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to reset Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically changed before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to reset the Klaro! Consent Management settings and then trigger the modal.
trans-unit.target: Klaro! Consent Management nulstilling-imut URL taarserneqartoq: Linkit placeholder-URL-imut tassunga sammisut HTML-output sioqqullugu automatiskimik allanngortinneqartarput. URL CSP-mut naleqquttumik JavaScriptimik taarserneqartarpoq Klaro! Consent Management-ip settings-ii nulstilling-erneqarlutik kingorna modal aallartinniarlugu.

trans-unit.source: Klaro! Configuration Path:If this path is set, external applications can use the Klaro! configuration generated by TYPO3. For example, a WordPress installation can load the TYPO3-generated configuration from this path. Example: "/klaro-config.js"
trans-unit.target: Klaro! configuration-ip aqqutaa: Aqqut una設定-erneqarsimappat, avataanit applications-it TYPO3-mit pilersinneqarsimasoq Klaro! configuration atorsinnaavaat. Assersuutigalugu WordPress-installation TYPO3-mit pilersinneqarsimasoq configuration aqqut manna aqqutigalugu load-ersinnaavaa. Assersuut: "/klaro-config.js"

trans-unit.source: Replace attributes:Comma-separated list of attributes that should be automatically replaced within the content element of the contextual consent
trans-unit.target: Attributit taarserlugit:Attributit komma-nik immikkoortinneqartut allattorsimaffiat, contextual consent-ip content element-iani automatiskimik taarserneqartussat

trans-unit.source: Main section only:Activate this option if the contextual consent box should be limited to the main content only (without heading and footer).
trans-unit.target: Immikkoortoq pingaarneq taamaallaat:Periarfissaq una atuutilersiguk, contextual consent box imarisamut pingaarnerinnarmut killeqartinneqassappat (qulequtaq footerilu ilanngunnagit).
